value.rationale: This exact reduced superspecial divisor completes the natural Cartier stratification of the M[7] marked genus-three plane-quartic family in the inert characteristic class left untreated by the generic-ordinary mass formula. It constructs superspecial smooth nonhyperelliptic curves in infinitely many characteristics with a canonical Prym explanation, and the geometric coefficient count m is the natural degree of the modular Deuring divisor, not an arbitrary slice. Newton-polygon availability and Legendre root enumeration alone are not claimed new.
